root.name: Benko Gambit Accepted: Fianchetto Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 c5 3. d5 b5 4. cxb5 a6 5. bxa6 g6 6. Nc3 Bxa6 7. g3 d6 8. Bg2 Bg7 9. Nf3

overview: White declines to attack and fianchettoes with g3 and Bg2, keeping the extra pawn while Black has half-open a- and b-files. Black fianchettoes too, castles and plays ...Nbd7 and ...Rb8 with long-term queenside pressure. The game is a slow positional fight with no quick tactics.

white_ideas.idea: Hold the extra pawn with Nd2 or Nf3 and play Bg2
Return the pawn at the right moment, with Nd2, Qc2 and a4

black_ideas.idea: Use the long diagonal and the half-open a- and b-files

typical_structures.structure: Benko structure: White d5 pawn against Black c5/d6, Black with half-open files

gambit.notes: White can keep the extra pawn.

character.reason: Long-term pressure rather than forcing play.

gambit.reason: Black gives a pawn for lasting pressure.

plans.reason: Both sides fianchetto; Black presses on the queenside.
